title: Anna Karenina

vibeProfile.oneLine: A woman risks everything for love, and a society punishes her for it.

summary: A married Petersburg beauty falls for the dashing Count Vronsky, and her open affair scandalises a society happy to forgive the same behaviour in men. Against Anna's slow ruin, Tolstoy sets the quieter, hopeful story of Levin, a landowner searching for a way to live honestly, and the contrast becomes a whole moral universe. Famous from its first line onward, it is a novel about love, hypocrisy, family and the impossible position of women, written with a tenderness and precision that make Anna's fate almost unbearable to watch.
whyReadIt: The great novel of love and social cruelty. Anna will break your heart, and Levin will quietly put it back together.

funFacts.text: Its opening line about happy and unhappy families is one of the most quoted first sentences in literature.
